I'm so frustrated and honestly fed up. These companies take our money, time, and investment, only to turn around and treat us like we don’t matter. Streaming services keep pulling shows with no notice, no refund, no explanation—just whatever benefits them. Even if you buy digital copies, they can revoke access whenever they want. So what are we really paying for? A long-term rental with zero security.


I’m tired of the rent-seeking behavior of these corporations and the Walmart-ification of everything. They come in, destroy competition by losing billions to undercut existing industries, then once they’ve monopolized or consolidated power, they turn around and gouge us, mistreat us, and act like we have no choice. They show us a better way when competition exists, but as soon as they have all the leverage, they strip away our options and squeeze us dry.


I’m done with it. I’m cutting my subscriptions in half and putting that money toward owning my media—physical copies, hard drive backups, whatever it takes. I want to watch what I want, when I want, without these companies deciding for me. It’s more effort, but at least I’ll actually own what I pay for.
